bindings.rationale: The service returned T1,T2 and reported exactly two matches.
Changing only the case to Tools produced zero matches.
UI state remained on the expected first page and the response contained the tools IDs in this starting state.
The page stayed 3 after selection, against the required reset to 1.
The API received page 3. The recorded call directly establishes the missing reset at dispatch.
Both identical requests returned the two tools IDs with one cache entry.
The same-category sequence returned the expected IDs when either page or size changed.
With page and size unchanged, the request for tools received the first books page. Wrong IDs alone contradict isolation by category.
The observed service slice equals the second pair of books in catalog order.
The API returned the first two books, next two books and first book for the respective page and size choices.
Direct service assertion compares the entire response to empty items, filtered total 2 and page 3. The API boundary is covered by composition inference only.

obligations.description: Return only exact category matches with the filtered total.

criteria.scopeDescription: Service only, fixed catalog. The tools/Tools pair exercises exact and case-sensitive selection plus filtered count. Generalization to other strings comes from the equality predicate in artifact-4 L4-L7.

After books page 3 changes to tools, UI state must be page 1.

criteria.scopeDescription: Check UI selection both on page 1 and after leaving that page. Separate the state observed after selection from the argument captured when get_items is entered.

comparisonContexts.description: Same tools request repeated returns the expected IDs twice with one cache entry.
For books, independently changing page or size changes the returned slice.
Books then tools, both page 1 size 2, must give each category's own rows and filtered total.

obligations.description: Cache results belong to the requested category, page and page_size on the same instance.

criteria.scopeDescription: Check one in-process instance per sequence, with fixed catalog. Test repetition, changes to page and size, and a category change holding page and size fixed. The second response's count in the last sequence has no reached assertion.

comparisonContexts.description: Books page 2 size 2 at the service must contain B3,B4.
One API instance: books page 1 size 2, page 2 size 2, then page 1 size 1 must return B1,B2; B3,B4; B1 respectively.
Service tools page 3 size 2 must return items [], total 2, page 3. Direct execution covers the service boundary.

obligations.description: Return ordered slices of at most the requested size for a fixed category.
Return an empty slice and preserve the filtered count beyond the last page.

criteria.scopeDescription: For a fixed category, service execution covers an in-range slice and an out-of-range empty page with preserved total. API execution directly covers ordered slices at pages 1 and 2 and sizes 2 and 1. API out-of-range behavior is inferred only: on a fresh miss the API returns and caches the unmodified service response (artifact-2 L10-L14, artifact-4 L4-L7). No API out-of-range assertion or repeated boundary request was offered; no inference across categories.

evidenceReviews.rationale: artifact-6 L13-L17 matches the named unit observation; passing assertions check the IDs and total for tools and the zero total for Tools.
artifact-6 L19-L22 checks books' middle slice and the complete tools out-of-range service response.
artifact-6 L29-L33 repeats the same tools request on one API instance and checks IDs twice and entry count.
artifact-6 L35-L39 exercises three in-range books requests on one API instance; assertions compare IDs rather than response totals.
artifact-6 L41-L46 starts on page 1 and checks the resulting category, page and IDs. It cannot distinguish reset from retaining page 1.
artifact-7 L8-L12 matches the page 3 state assertion failure (3 != 1). The later IDs assertion was not reached.
artifact-8 L8-L17 records the arguments at entry. Its assertion reports ('tools',3,2) in place of ('tools',1,2).
artifact-8 L19-L25 shows books IDs passed for the first call; the second IDs assertion failed with B1,B2; the final total assertion was not reached.

risk.rationale: Stateful navigation and cache reuse can display a wrong or empty catalog after category changes. Scope is a reversible, fixed public synthetic catalog in one process.
